name: Bode plot
description: The gain and the phase of a circuit against frequency (a Bode plot) with a function generator and an oscilloscope: at every frequency the generator feeds a sine, the scope reads the input and the output together and a sine is fitted to each, so the gain and the phase come out even with a lot of noise. The vertical scales are adjusted by themselves at every frequency. Gives the -3 dB bandwidth and the peaking and, for a loop gain, the crossover frequency, the phase margin and the gain margin, with a pass / fail check. The generator is switched off at the end, also after an error.

roles.name: generator
roles.description: The function generator that feeds the circuit with a sine

roles.name: oscilloscope
roles.description: The oscilloscope: one channel on the input of the circuit, one on its output

device.description: label (identifies the circuit) and asset_id (its code in the registry)

source.description: the generator: channel, amplitude_vpp (peak to peak) and offset_v

scope.description: input_channel, output_channel, probe_attenuation, coupling (AC|DC), cycles (periods shown, 5 by default), memory_depth, bandwidth_limit_hz, input_volts_per_div and output_volts_per_div (the starting scales, then adjusted)

settle_s.description: wait after every change of frequency (0.5 s by default)

capture_wait_s.description: wait after starting an acquisition before reading it (0.3 s by default)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {curves: [{trace, view, tolerance}], summary: {figure: tolerance}, min_overlap}

loop.description: the circuit is a loop gain: find the crossover, the phase margin and the gain margin

phase_offset_deg.description: added to the phase (180 for a loop measured with an inverting injection)

phase_start_deg.description: the phase of the first point is taken within 180 degrees of this

safety.description: max_amplitude_vpp: a larger generator amplitude is refused before anything is switched on

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to connect the generator and the scope
